note: ordinary deep ARM id, mixed casing -> ASCII A-Z folded to a-z, nothing else
doubled and trailing slashes stay DISTINCT (never collapsed)
already-lowercase id is idempotent under the fold
Turkish dotted capital I (U+0130) is non-ASCII: passes through UNCHANGED (NOT i-dot). Proves divergence from str.lower()/locale lower().
German sharp-s (U+00DF) passes through unchanged (str.lower keeps it, Unicode casefold would expand to ss). Proves ASCII-only fold.
accented e (U+00E9) is non-ASCII and preserved; the ASCII C is folded
percent-encoded bytes are ASCII-folded ONLY, never percent-decoded (%C3%A9 -> %c3%a9)
percent-encoded space (%20) hex digits unchanged; surrounding ASCII folded
digits, dots, dashes and underscores are untouched; only A-Z folds
